closure-node.text: ide_call_hierarchy for Go: a call inside a function literal gives a CLOSURE node at the line of the literal, and the callers of the outer function are absent.

interface-calls-option-off.text: ide_call_hierarchy shows no caller for a Go method that is called only through an interface value. The Hierarchy window of GoLand shows the same in its default state: its toggle "Respecting Interface Calls" is off by default, and the tool has no parameter for it (note "No caller through an interface" in live-test/real-products/_snapshots/caddy/GROUND-TRUTH.md).

other-build-configuration.text: A use or a declaration in a file that only another OS build compiles: the build constraints exclude the file on the IDE host. For a declaration in such a file, GoLand says "Nothing found" and shows a banner about the OS mismatch (note "Build constraints" in live-test/real-products/_snapshots/caddy/GROUND-TRUTH.md).

python-property-callers.text: ide_call_hierarchy in PyCharm on a property: the tree is empty, while ide_find_usages returns the reads of the property.

receiver-type-does-not-declare.text: ide_find_usages and ide_call_hierarchy in PyCharm: a call on a receiver with a known type that does not declare the method is absent, with no signal.
